text: The change gives eight existing TEST registrations across four suites TestMsg-prefixed labels and aligns their mach gtest invocation globs. The method names and test algorithms are unchanged by this patch. Current build files put the corresponding sources in xul-gtest. The reported CI name filter remains unpaired upstream context; no GTest or CI run occurred, and these local examples do not define a global test-naming rule.
title: Mailnews GTest invocation comments follow the registered suite names
